description: ACT Government publishes this polygon inventory of municipal assets in the Australian Capital Territory. Subtypes include offices, amenities buildings, pump sheds and other municipal structures. The provider describes attributes for structure dimensions, floor area, construction materials and counts of sanitary facilities. Assets are captured through works-as-executed handover or field audits. Coverage is limited to assets owned or managed by the named ACT government services; private, federal and other directorate assets may be absent. The Socrata catalogue and JSON view metadata are public and free to inspect. The native listing does not state a licence. Caveats: only metadata was inspected, no dataset rows or geometry values were downloaded. Field definitions do not establish field completeness or current asset condition. For infrastructure simulation, building footprints and physical attributes can support exposure and asset-stock representation; occupancy and structural fragility are not established. Related catalogue: ACT Government open data portal.
